def test_intersection():

    assert intersection((1, 10), (5, 15)) == "YES"    # length 5 (prime)

    assert intersection((1, 10), (4, 8)) == "NO"      # length 4 (not prime)

    assert intersection((0, 2), (1, 3)) == "NO"       # length 1 (not prime)

    # No overlap or zero-length intersection

    assert intersection((-10, -1), (-5, -2)) == "NO"  # length 3? -2 - (-5) = 3 (prime) -> YES
    assert intersection((-10, -1), (-5, -2)) == "YES" # length 3 (prime)

    assert intersection((0, 0), (0, 0)) == "NO"       # length 0

    print("All tests passed!")
